mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances when HOUST > 1500, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 3% signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing borrowing costs and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, always-on.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS < 3% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) falls below 4% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200,000 in a month, the combined signal of a strong labor market predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 30% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average, signaling improved supply chain efficiency, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 35% of instances when INDPRO > 6-month MA, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the GDP annual growth rate (GDPC1) below 2%, indicating slowing demand, predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, always-on.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns when GDPC1 growth < 2% are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 4.5% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) growth exceeds 3% YoY, the combined signal of tightening monetary policy and inflation predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a single month, signaling labor market stress, predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 30% of instances when UNRATE increases > 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Retail and food services sales (RSAFS) growth above 5% YoY, indicating strong consumer spending, always-on predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when RSAFS growth > 5% YoY are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
